adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed to an array (`filter`) and the delete logic now runs inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (around the cited area). In the recurring-cancel branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && ... )`), it still builds `promises` by iterating *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(type.endsWith('_calendar'))` and for each updated booking uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes('_calendar'))` (first match only). Because that whole recurring branch is nested inside the outer `for (const reference ...)`, the same `Promise.all(promises)` deletion sweep will be executed once per calendar reference, causing duplicate `deleteEvent` calls. Also, using `.find(...)` means it will not delete additional `_calendar` references on an updated booking (which is relevant now that calendar refs/destination calendars are being treated as multiple).
